caveats: This dataset is intended for humanitarian use only. It reflects interim adjustments to administrative boundaries and population figures pending a comprehensive government update of all administrative levels and census data, expected in 2027.
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other:
Dataset: The dataset is derived from 2017 administrative boundaries and census data produced by the Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE) and the national mapping agency Administração Nacional de Terras e Geografia. Due to misalignment between ADM4 and ADM3 boundaries, WFP and OCHA Mozambique in coordination with the Government and IMWG, applied non-official adjustments to correct discrepancies for humanitarian use. These adjustments include aligning ADM4 boundaries with higher administrative levels and updating population figures to reflect projections for 2017–2050, particularly in conflict-affected areas. The current dataset represents this harmonized version prepared by WFP and OCHA Mozambique. Official government updates to administrative boundaries and census data are expected in 2027.  
  
P-codes: Updated P-codes for ADM1 and ADM2 were developed and shared bythe Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE) for reference. As no official P-codes were provided for ADM3 and ADM4 levels, new codes were generated by alphabetically sorting administrative unit names within the established structure. This approach ensures internal consistency but remains non-official.
name: cod-ab-moz
notes:
Mozambique administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02.  
  
This dataset is structured into 4 levels:  
- Admin 1: 11 província  
- Admin 2: 161 distrito  
- Admin 3: 457 posto  
- Admin 4: 1712 localidade  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 10 March 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 01 January 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 10 March 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 January 2017: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Mozambique](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-mozambique-hat).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
